options.name: label
options.description: Visible label (accessible name).

options.name: nodes
options.description: The tree (see Tree View).

options.name: mode
options.description: Single choice or multiple choice with checkboxes and tags.

options.name: value
options.description: Selected node ids (at most one in single mode).

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name; one hidden input per selected id.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Placeholder while nothing is selected.

options.name: description
options.description: Help text below the field.

options.name: required
options.description: At least one value is required.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Not interactive and not submitted by Form.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Focusable, but the value cannot change.

options.name: invalid
options.description: Show errorMessage as an external error.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Message shown while invalid is true.

options.name: clearable
options.description: Show a button that clears the selection.

options.name: selectableParents
options.description: Single mode: parents can be chosen; otherwise choosing a parent opens it.

options.name: cascade
options.description: Multiple mode: checking a parent checks its descendants.

options.name: expanded
options.description: Ids expanded in the popup tree (paths to the value are expanded too).

options.name: loadChildren
options.type: ((node: TreeNode, context: TreeViewLoadContext) => Promise<readonly TreeNode[]>) | null
options.description: Lazy children (see Tree View).

options.name: valueLabels
options.description: Labels of selected ids whose nodes are not loaded yet.

options.name: popupHeight
options.description: Block size of the tree in the popup.

options.name: direction
options.description: Popup placement and tree arrow keys.

options.name: density
options.description: Row height of the popup tree.

options.name: icons
options.description: Expand, clear, remove, and error icons.

options.name: openOnFocus
options.description: Open the popup when the field receives focus.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of messages and filtering.

properties.name: tree
properties.description: The Tree View in the popup.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: The value differs from the initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: The field lost focus at least once.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: The id (single) or ids (multiple) for Form.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear interaction state.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user changed the value: { value, added, removed }.

cssClasses.name: aui-tree-select__label | __control | __input
cssClasses.description: Label, field boundary, and search input.

cssClasses.name: aui-tree-select__popup | __tree
cssClasses.description: Top-layer popup and the Tree View host.

cssClasses.name: aui-tree-select__description | __error | __values
cssClasses.description: Help text, error message, hidden inputs.
